_drafted_note: Drafted 2026-08-23 from the world's OWN archipelago.json, README and releases. No field is filled in from memory or from what other games on the same platform do.
_platform_source: README: "a separate build of the Perfect Dark PC port". The PC port is the target, not the Nintendo 64 cartridge.
description: Rare's Perfect Dark as a multiworld, played through the fan PC port.
_description_source: written by us from the structure of the game -- no text copied from the game itself
_checks_verified_note: Stays false until somebody has played it through London. Built is not tested.
_requires_source: the PC port needs the data files from a Perfect Dark ROM the player owns
_mod_kind_source: the world targets fgsfdsfgs/perfect_dark, a fan decompilation of the Nintendo 64 game rebuilt to run natively on PC. It is the same game, not a new one -- so fan_port, not fan_game.

client.name: Perfect Dark Client
client._kind_source: the release ships pd-ap-x86_64-windows-<version>.zip -- its own AP-integrated build of the game, client included. London launches it and stands aside; nothing of ours reads its memory.
client._protocol_source: the world opens its own connection to the game -- no emulator memory protocol is involved, so London carries nothing but the launch. Recorded as "self" rather than naming a bridge we do not use.

apworld._source: the repository's own releases page, read 2026-08-23 (8 releases, latest pd-v0.4.0)

_install_kind_source: two pieces: perfect_dark.apworld into custom_worlds, and the AP build of the port itself. London can carry the apworld; the port build is the player's.
setup: Download perfect_dark.apworld and pd-ap-x86_64-windows-<version>.zip from the release.
Put perfect_dark.apworld in Archipelago's custom_worlds folder.
Extract the zip and give it the data from your own Perfect Dark ROM, as the port requires.
Launch the AP build and connect it to the room.

patch._source: the setup guide describes no patching step

_patch_extension_source: world source not downloaded -- repo policy is addresses only. Flagged in every build until somebody reads it.

world_by.name: ajeloom
world_by._source: the repository that publishes this world, read 2026-08-23
world_by._licence_source: read from the repository's LICENSE file 2026-08-23 -- the MIT text Archipelago itself carries (LLCoolDave, Berserker66, CaitSith2, LegendaryLinux). The world lives in a fork of Archipelago and inherits its licence file.

credits._note: The game is Rare's and is never distributed here; the player supplies their own copy. The PC port is by fgsfdsfgs and contributors, credited in the world's own README. The Archipelago world is ajeloom's. Only the plugin itself is by solida1987.
